# ISP by Address Canada

> Check which internet service providers (ISPs) are available at any Canadian address. Compare speeds, technologies, and pricing using ISED National Broadband Data covering 16.6 million points.

## What This Site Does

ISP by Address Canada helps Canadians find internet providers at their exact address. It uses the Government of Canada's ISED broadband coverage dataset to show:

- Which ISPs serve a given address
- Available download and upload speeds (50/10, 25/5, 10/2, 5/1 Mbps tiers)
- Connection technologies (fibre, cable, DSL, fixed wireless, LTE, satellite)
- Coverage maps by province and territory
- Data confidence scoring based on spatial accuracy and data freshness

## Coverage

All 13 provinces and territories:
- Ontario, Quebec, British Columbia, Alberta, Manitoba, Saskatchewan
- Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Prince Edward Island
- Northwest Territories, Yukon, Nunavut

## Data Source

ISED (Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada) National Broadband Data.
Updated periodically from the government's open dataset covering 16.6 million Populated Household (PHH) points.

## Languages

Available in English (ispbyaddress.ca) and French (ispbyaddress.ca/fr).

## API

REST API available at /api/v1/lookup for programmatic address lookups.
Documentation: https://ispbyaddress.ca/api-docs

## Contact

Website: https://ispbyaddress.ca
